property_summary: For any call that satisfies the preconditions (msg.value == 10 ether and block.timestamp > prior pastBlockTime), the reference contract always sets pastBlockTime equal to the current block.timestamp after the fallback returns; the mutant that assigns block.number instead will cause pastBlockTime != block.timestamp for some inputs (when block.number != block.timestamp), so the invariant can be violated.
change_summary: Change assignment to pastBlockTime to set it to block.number rather than block.timestamp, altering the stored value observed later.
